# Package Information

This package is published on npm: [mbkbucket](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mbkbucket)

## Installation

```bash
npm install mbkbucket
```

## What's Included

- **Library** — Full S3/R2 bucket management API (upload, download, list, delete, multipart, signed URLs)
- **Express Router** — Ready-to-use admin dashboard with Handlebars templates
- **CLI** — Command-line interface for managing buckets from the terminal ⚠️ *under development*

## Registry

Published to: npm Registry (https://registry.npmjs.org/)
